lmx.objective.traffic.zh: 流量 — 把人带到站点

lmx.objective.sales.en: Sales — optimize on a pixel event
lmx.objective.sales.zh: 转化 — 按像素事件优化

lmx.eventHint.en: Meta needs roughly 50 of the chosen event a week to leave the learning phase. Pick the densest event on the way to a sale, not the rarest.
lmx.eventHint.zh: Meta 大约需要每周 50 次所选事件才能走出学习期。请选通往成交路径上最密集的事件，而不是最稀少的那个。

lmx.optimizes.zh: 按像素 {pixel} 的{event}优化，统计窗口为 {attribution}

lmx.pixelUnverified.en: Meta would not list this account's pixels, so pixel {pixel} is unverified. The first paused ad set in Ads Manager is the check.
lmx.pixelUnverified.zh: Meta 未返回该账户的像素列表，因此像素 {pixel} 尚未验证。请在广告管理工具里检查第一个暂停的广告组。

lr2.issue.conversionGoal.en: A Sales campaign optimizes toward a pixel event. Choose the conversion goal, or switch the campaign back to Traffic.
lr2.issue.conversionGoal.zh: 转化广告需按像素事件优化。请选择转化目标，或把广告目标改回流量。

lr2.issue.conversionObjective.en: Optimizing toward a pixel event needs the Sales objective. Switch the campaign to Sales, or choose a click goal.
lr2.issue.conversionObjective.zh: 按像素事件优化需要转化目标。请把广告目标改为转化，或改选点击类目标。

lr2.issue.conversionEvent.en: Choose the pixel event this campaign optimizes toward.
lr2.issue.conversionEvent.zh: 请选择本广告优化的像素事件。

lr2.issue.conversionEventUnused.en: A Traffic campaign optimizes toward clicks, not a pixel event. Clear the event, or switch the campaign to Sales.
lr2.issue.conversionEventUnused.zh: 流量广告按点击优化，不使用像素事件。请清除事件，或把广告目标改为转化。

lr2.issue.conversionPixel.en: No pixel is resolved for this ad account. Share the crazydramas pixel with it in Business settings, then read the accounts again.
lr2.issue.conversionPixel.zh: 该广告账户没有可用像素。请在商务设置中把 crazydramas 像素共享给它，然后重新读取账户。

lr2.issue.conversionPixelUnused.en: A Traffic campaign uses no pixel. Clear it, or switch the campaign to Sales.
lr2.issue.conversionPixelUnused.zh: 流量广告不使用像素。请清除像素，或把广告目标改为转化。

lr2.issue.conversionPixelShape.en: The pixel id is not a Meta pixel id.
lr2.issue.conversionPixelShape.zh: 该像素 ID 不是有效的 Meta 像素 ID。

lr2.issue.conversionLink.en: Conversions are counted by the crazydramas pixel, so the ad must point at a crazydramas series. Choose the drama again, or switch the campaign to Traffic.
lr2.issue.conversionLink.zh: 转化由 crazydramas 像素统计，因此广告必须指向 crazydramas 的剧集。请重新选择剧集，或把广告目标改为流量。

lmx.attribution.zh: 点击后 7 天、浏览后 1 天
